correctness.rationale: The repaired theorem is for the limiting variance per label and for a joint CLT at fixed interior retention, not a finite-size or moving-window optimizer. Shared leaves are labels vacant in both Prüfer words; single-position avoidance gives the finite factorial and cross-moment identities, with empty products at n=2. In m log a_{n,k} the coefficient of k²/n is c=(1−ρ)−(2−ρ)²/2, so the covariance contribution to the variance density is 2cQ², Q=e^(ρ−2). This gives v=Q−(3−2ρ+ρ²)Q². The positivity bound uses (3−ρ)Q≤2/e; the sign bracket for v' is 1−2(2−ρ+ρ²)Q, strictly decreasing from positive to negative, so exactly one strict maximum. For the Gaussian law, the shared stream count S is binomial in latent retention decisions, not observed coincidences; its conditioning leaves three independent fixed-total allocations. In the conditional characteristic-function integral, positivity of rates bounds the probabilities of Poisson box-count differences e_j away from zero. The independent-copy cosine identity then bounds 1−|φ|² from below by c||θ||²−C/n for small θ, giving Gaussian domination after θ=u/√n; on the complement the unperturbed modulus is uniformly below one and bounded f adds O(n⁻¹ᐟ²). The resulting conditional covariance is a Schur complement; the exact conditional mean differs from Poisson centering by O(1). The correction subtracts q² from each marginal leaf variance, ρq² from their covariance, qQ from marginal/common covariance, and (2−ρ)Q² from common variance. The conditional mean g_n(S) of H has derivative tending to Q at E S and second derivative O(1/n). The binomial fluctuation is asymptotically independent of the conditional limit by bounded conditional characteristic functions converging to a deterministic limit. It adds ρ(1−ρ)Q² to the last variance only; the matrix agrees with separate finite second-moment expansions. No field or other tree-coupling result is asserted.

value.rationale: Even after removing the exact finite transform from the contribution, the result gives a sharp and interpretable nonmonotonicity: limiting noise of a natural common-leaf statistic is worst at a strictly intermediate retain probability, not at either baseline endpoint. The joint Gaussian limit identifies how that overlap covaries with each marginal leaf total, including fluctuation from the randomized shared-stream size. These are meaningful properties of the coupled-tree null model rather than a rebranding of known finite vacancy moments.
